name: Academy of the Elite
source:
Academy Of The Elite is a story where you the mc will attend a prestigious fantasy magic Academy, where your goal is to raise the rankings of the school, and complete challenges with your classmates… You’ll take upon a leadership role within your class
and it’s your responsibility to make sure you can overcome those challenges. You’ll meet a lot of girls along the way. Monster girls and normal girls… Who doesn’t like a big harem with a big variety of girls right?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Chaosborn]Patreon[/url]]
